additionalParamVariables.description:
The additional variables provided by the ReduxAction.  Generally used when the redirect is using a
{@link UiSdlEffectPayloadForwarder#payloadStrategy} of MERGE

applicationStateId.description:
The id of an optional {@link UiSdlApplicationState}.  Required if #applicationStateParamVariables are
provided

applicationStateParamVariables.description:
The params to derive from an optional {@link UiSdlApplicationState}.  Must have an #applicationStateId.
{@see UiSdlApplicationState.getConfigFromApplicationState}

browserRedirect.description:
Whether or not to use the {@link GenAiUiBasicRedirectEpic} or not.  When true this will resolve the url and use
`window.location.href = ${url}`

openInNewTab.description: When true this will resolve the url and use `window.open(${url})`

routeParams.description:
The params for the {@link UiSdlRoute} if required.  These should be in the already resolved format
`{key: value}` where the key is part of the target route.
example `"users/{{id}}" {id: '123'}`

statePageParamVariables.description:
The params to derive from the {@link UiSdlReduxState}.
{@see UiSdlConnected#getPageParamFromState}

targetModuleName.description: The name of the {@link UiSdlRoute#targetModuleName} to redirect to.  Used to find the {@link UiSdlRoute}

targetPageName.description: The name of the {@link UiSdlRoute#targetPageName} to redirect to.  Used to find the {@link UiSdlRoute}

url.description:
The url to redirect to.  This will be used instead of by finding the {@link UiSdlRoute} from the
#targetModuleName and #targetPageName
